product_metadata.title: DomeStar 150PCS Premium Blue Fake Ice, Acrylic Ice Rocks Plastic Rocks Acrylic Stones Crushed Ice Cubes Diamonds Gems for Vase Fillers Decoration
features: Packing List - 150 x Assorted Acrylic Ice Rocks

4 Different Designs-Our crushed ice rocks come in 4 different colors including clear rocks, light blue rocks, sky blue rocks and dark blue rocks. Each rock is irregular, but measures approximately 1 x 0.7 x 0.6 inches.

High Quality-Each of our simulated ice rocks are made of high quality acrylic, non-toxic and odorless, with irregular shapes and realistic appearance, light but not settling in water, beautifully polished and not rough on the edges.
Wide Applicable-Our crushed ice set is great for food displays, table centerpieces, DIY candles, vase fillers, photo props, fish tank fillers. Perfect for home decor.
Buying Tip - All ice rocks will not cool your water or wine. Rocks will sink in water.
